usedFor: Lago tracks your billing, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computers when “New Payment Arrives” fires “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment Arrives” in Lago, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Each new payment can start a script on your own machine, such as one that files a receipt.

watchOut: “New Payment Arrives” in Lago is polling, so “Trigger Command” runs after a scheduled check.
